ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Using DNA recombination technology can endow organisms with new genetic characteristics and create biological products more in line with human needs. In this process, many kinds of tool enzymes need to be used, among which the cutting sites of 4 restriction endonucleases are shown in the figure. Answer the question: Commonly used DNA ligases include E. coli DNA ligase and T4DNA ligase. DNA fragments cut by what enzymes in the figure above can be ligated by E. coli DNA ligase?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Using DNA recombination technology can endow organisms with new genetic characteristics and create biological products more in line with human needs. In this process, many kinds of tool enzymes need to be used, among which the cutting sites of 4 restriction endonucleases are shown in the figure. Answer the question: Commonly used DNA ligases include E. coli DNA ligase and T4DNA ligase. DNA fragments cut by what enzymes in the figure above can be ligated by E. coli DNA ligase?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure lists the recognition sequences and cutting positions of 4 restriction enzymes. EcoRI corresponds to GAATTC/CTTAAG, and the cuts are staggered on the two strands; SmaI corresponds to CCCGGG/GGGCCC, and the cuts are symmetrical in the middle; PstI corresponds to CTGCAG/GACGTC, and the cuts are staggered on the two strands; EcoRV corresponds to GATATC/CTATAG, and the cuts are symmetrical in the middle. Then reason: E. coli DNA ligase usually ligates DNA fragments with complementary sticky ends, but cannot effectively ligate blunt ends. Staggered cutting forms sticky ends, and symmetrical cutting forms blunt ends. Therefore the DNA fragments cut by EcoRI and PstI can be ligated with E. coli DNA ligase.
